messages:
Sam: Pushed PRD draft for combined API surface changes (chat/completions + embeddings + rerank). Need quick alignment on launch gates, acceptance per-endpoint, and edge-case test vectors before I send to PMs.

Maria: Link pls? Also flagging FinCorp and Acme as driving asks; FinCorp requires EU-only logs + 90d retention.

Sam: https://redwood.example/drive/prd-api-combined-v2 (draft)
Acme: deterministic rerank fallback + stable scoring for short contexts. FinCorp: strict data residency and audit logs.

Alex: Suggest splitting acceptance by endpoint. Chat (non-streaming): p50 < 90ms, p95 < 320ms @ 2k tokens. Streaming: time-to-first-byte p95 < 140ms. Completions quality: perplexity delta <= 0.5 vs prod baseline on eval set.

Elaine: Embeddings acceptance: cosine similarity drift < 8e-4 vs canonical model, and throughput >= 250/s on dedicated-4 with batch size 64. Add regression CI that runs every PR on a small held-out dataset.

Govind: Rerank acceptance: normalized NDCG >= current-prod on labeled set; auto-rollback if NDCG drops > 1.5 pts in canary. Also require determinism test: identical inputs + seed -> identical scores.

Ruth: Rollout plan proposal:
- micro-canary 0.5% for 12h (health + smoke)
- canary 3% for 24h (quality & perf)
- ramp 25% for 48h
- 75% for 24h
- 100% after 7d stability check
Include an immediate rollback hook and on-call paging for >0.5% error spike.

Sam: OK. Need exact metrics to plumb into Console:
- per-route p50/p95 latency
- time-to-first-byte (streaming)
- tokens emitted and token cost per request
- ndcg_delta, mse_delta, cosine_drift
- retry/fallback counts and %
- env:data_residency flag per-tenant

Alex: Proposed rollout policy snippet (example):
```
rollout_policy:
  micro_canary: 0.5
  canary: 3
  metrics_guards:
    - name: ndcg_delta
      action: rollback_if_breach
      threshold: -1.5
    - name: p95_latency_ms
      action: pause_and_alert
      threshold: 600
  auto_rollback: true
  alert_window_minutes: 30
```

Maria: FinCorp gating must be explicit: EU-only access, no logs exported to US, retention <= 90 days, KMS-managed keys. Mark as blocking for their tenant rollout.

Elaine: QA checklist additions: empty prompt handling, >8k token truncation semantics, unicode normalization (NFKC), tokenization mismatch tests, streaming reconnect resume across TCP disconnects, kv-cache snapshot/restore across restarts, and prompt-injection detection smoke.

Govind: Perf runs scheduled: staging perf on dedicated-4 vs hosted baseline next Wed 9am PT. I'll run synthetic & trace sampling.

Sam: I'll update PRD with endpoint-specific acceptance sections, rollout policy yaml snippet, gating items for FinCorp, and per-endpoint edge-case test vectors. Will ping when I update the draft.
